text:
alex: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to clarify "preemption" vs "eviction" behavior for Dedicated capacity. I tried to keep it short but added a small SDK rollback example.

maria: saw it, nice. Can you split the behavioral section into two bullets? users keep mixing terms in support tickets.

alex: good call. splitting now.

jen: quick Q — does the rollback example cover both autoscale and reserved-pool changes? we had a customer hit a partial scale down and want clear guidance.

alex: right now it shows autoscale policy patch + a safe rollback hook for the runtime. Not the reserved-pool migration flow. I can add a short note for pool changes.

paul: also, add a line about network isolation: when you migrate a customer to a reserved pool in a different VPC, routes need to be updated before failover. link to the migration playbook would help.

alex: added a one-liner and a link to the playbook (internal): https://redwood.internal/playbooks/reserved-pool-migration

maria: can you show the python SDK snippet inline? FRANK from support asked for copy-pasteable code.

alex: pasted a minimal example:

```python
# patch autoscale policy and attach rollback hook
from redwood_sdk import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()

policy = {
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 8,
  "scale_up_threshold": 0.7
}

resp = client.update_autoscale_policy(pool_id="pool-1234", policy=policy)
# rollback helper
if resp.status_code != 200:
    client.update_autoscale_policy(pool_id="pool-1234", policy={"min_replicas":1, "max_replicas":4})
```

jen: nice and simple. maybe use exceptions instead of status_code check to match SDK style.

alex: updated snippet to use try/except in the PR.

deploy-bot: PR #8562 updated: docs/ dedicated/preemption.md — 3 files changed. CI: spellcheck passed.

paul: one more wording nit — SLA section says "best-effort fallback" — change to "tiered fallback: dedicated -> hosted-compatible-variant -> hosted". clearer for customers.

alex: done, changed wording.

docs-bot: friendly reminder: please add reviewers from product and support teams for Dedicated docs changes.

maria: tagging @jen and @paul as reviewers. will do one pass after you add the reserved-pool note.

alex: thanks — I pushed the reserved-pool migration note and the exception-based SDK rollback. ready for review.

jen: will review in ~30m. :thumbsup:
